_comment: The owner-identifier gate's per-repo lists: config files to read for account names, and local-data files allowed to hold an identifier, each with a reason.

localDataReasons..github/CODEOWNERS: GitHub requires the repository owner's handle in the code-owners file.
localDataReasons.CLAUDE.md: Names the GitHub account and Project the backlog lives in.
localDataReasons.engine/html-export.ts: Oliver is the export file format's name: the data-oliver-* attributes and the title that the importer reads back.
localDataReasons.engine/pptx-export.ts: Oliver is the name of the exported theme, which the PowerPoint importer matches.
localDataReasons.slideeditor.html: The built editor carries the same Oliver export format names as engine/html-export.ts and engine/pptx-export.ts.
localDataReasons.engine/pptx-parts.ts: Oliver is the name of the exported theme, which the PowerPoint importer matches. Moved here from engine/pptx-export.ts.
